name: Obfuscated Logical Reductions
description: Redefined the relaxed scenarios as modified scheduling problems (e.g., setting one phase's duration to 0 and removing its grid's capacity constraint) whose minimum makespans mathematically evaluate to exactly the same sums as the original independent-workload conditions. This forces models to deduce the bottleneck of a relaxed schedule rather than pattern-matching keywords to simple sums, and intentionally inverts the keywords (e.g. LOAD 1 mentions "System Initialization" but evaluates to sum(p1)) to trap skimming models.
